title: MORABO chaise
description: MORABO chaise, add-on unit, Grann/Bomstad golden brown/wood Use this MORABO chaise longue section with other sections in the series to create the perfect sofa for you and your space. Perfect when you want to stretch out for a while and read a book or watch a movie.
features: Suitable only for use as add-on chaise to the LANDSKRONA sofa series, cannot be used on its own.
The seat cushion and back cushion are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.

Grain leather is treated with a light protective surface coating to retain its natural look with marks, wrinkles and color variations. Therefore it´s also less resistant to sunlight, dirt, liquids and scratches than leather with a thick surface treatment
Sleeves for the legs to match the cover are included.
materialAndCare: Back and seat frame: Plywood, Solid pine, Fiberboard; Back cushion: Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft.; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft.; Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Solid wood, Oak veneer, Clear lacquer
